objective: Preallocate inverted-index top-level maps for the first indexed document.

tasks.title: Preallocate inverted-index top-level maps
tasks.result: InvertedIndex initialization now reserves capacity for the first postings and document-length entries.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The initial capacity is 1 because a newly constructed inverted index commonly receives its first document immediately after initialization.
The optimization only changes initial HashMap allocation for empty postings and document-length maps; tokenization, BM25 scoring, duplicate document semantics, and result ordering are unchanged.
